nodes.text: @Subok33642799 @Oldboatie Suppose you hadn't caught say human metapneumovirus for 20y. In that time it will have gone through a lot of mutations and your immune memory of it will no longer be a good match. (There is currently no approved vaccine for metapneumovirus.)
